init_PyTouch_with_sensor: create a PyTouch instance with a sensor class and optional tasks
init_PyTouch_with_source: create a PyTouch instance with a sensor and a specific SensorDataSources type
init_PyTouch_with_tasks: create a PyTouch instance with a sensor and a list of task classes to initialize
init_sensor_method: initialize a sensor instance from a sensor class with RAW data source
init_tasks_method: initialize task classes by instantiating them with the sensor and attaching as attributes
